Radiation shield standard interface inner diameter 55 mm, 6.3 mm step shown on the data-sheet drawing.

notes: Outer dimensions (94 x 94 x 232 cm, < 600 kg; electronics rack 60 x 80 x 168 cm, < 250 kg; ceiling clearance >= 232 cm to open the sample loader) come from kiutra's 'Installation Requirements L-Type Rapid Cryostat' PDF. That PDF's original URL now returns 404 and the current copy at https://kiutra.com/resources/l-type-rapid-installation-requirements is gated behind a contact form, so the figures were recovered from the search-engine index of the document, not read directly from the file; treat them as lower-confidence than the other quotes. 'cryogen' is set to cryogen_free_pulse_tube because the enum has no generic closed-cycle option; kiutra's sources only say 'closed-cycle refrigeration' with a compressor and coldhead, never naming the cooler type. Stray field at sample < 50 uT with all ADR magnets powered (kiutra technology page). 3P55 turnaround 4.5 h: cooldown < 4 h, warmup and puck exchange < 0.5 h.
